name: rattletrap-android
description: Rattletrap as an Android app (Capacitor), with AdMob ads

scripts.web: node ../tools/build.js android && rm -rf www && cp -R ../dist/android www
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync android
scripts.debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
